feed.title: Depots: Theft-Proof, Self-Custodial Bitcoin For Billions Of Users

entry.title: Depots: Theft-Proof, Self-Custodial Bitcoin For Billions Of Users
entry.summary: The discussion highlights the limitations of relying solely on a seed phrase for data recovery, emphasizing that a seed phrase might not suffice due to the dynamic nature of depot and channel information. This evolving data necessitates an automatic encrypted backup solution that remains up-to-date to ensure complete recovery. It is crucial to communicate this requirement clearly to users, ensuring they understand the need for ongoing backups beyond the initial seed phrase to maintain access to their data over time. This approach not only enhances data security but also facilitates easier restoration processes for users in case of data loss.
